rules: Completed means acceptance evidence exists, not merely an output path.
Failed nodes block dependent positive claims; negative closeout is a separate branch.
One logical owner per output; research-lead may assign independent implementation owners but serializes shared writes.
Checkpoints bind source, inputs, settings, environment, successful exit and outputs.
Native and scaled work require explicit preceding gate advancement.

nodes.objective: Freeze mandate, six-family selection, hostile prior-art boundary and protocol
inputs: User launch mandate recorded in AGENTS.md
acceptance: Explicit conditional selection and strongest composition
Sole authorship and safety constraints recovered
Operational kill gates and negative-result route

nodes.objective: Complete Protocol Gate 0 finite oracle, controls, seed reversal and reproducible evidence
acceptance: 13 canonical gates pass across eight cases and five configurations
13 behavioral regression tests pass
Both seed baselines credited and joint outcome sets equal under reversed order
Finite witness replay, immutable bundles, and no native claim
downstream_evidence: G2 exact bounded reference and strong elementary null

nodes.objective: Execute Protocol Gate 1: kill or substantiate a product-aware mechanism beyond composition
acceptance: Pin and attempt actual PerSeVerE semantic comparison; unavailable is not passed
Publish finite grammar before enumeration: at most eight events, two actors, two preemptions, values 0/1
Implement strong B4 and explicit-observer null before candidate comparison
Exact bounded outcome preservation, dependency-mutant counterexamples and substantive separation
Stop after the protocol investment cap or known-method equivalence; failed decision need not fabricate proof/result outputs
downstream_evidence: G3 may start only after an explicit advancement decision
G7 may close a killed method honestly

nodes.objective: Execute Protocol Gate 2 restricted native supervisor and source-to-SQLite feasibility
acceptance: Safe disposable root, no privileged/security changes
Separate process/IPC supervision from FUSE request control
Admitted materialized image and real recovery, with no ext4 equivalence assertion
At least 9/10 bad-witness replay; supported negative controls 10/10; unsupported events refused
Missing dependencies or unsupported behavior blocks native acceptance
downstream_evidence: G4 supported native intersection and calibrated checker interfaces

nodes.objective: Execute Protocol Gate 3 on exactly six preregistered real workflow classes
acceptance: One license-clear pinned workflow from each W1-W6 class before faults
No target fault injection or artificial upstream promise
Matched B0-B6 budgets and outcome coverage; incremental real schedule-conditioned witness
Protocol 10x versus B0 and 2x end-to-end versus B4 gates, replay/triage/checker/prevention checks

nodes.objective: Execute Protocol Gate 4 on twenty distinct real workflows only after pilot advancement
acceptance: Frozen 4+3+4+4+3+2 roster with shared-project dependence disclosed
Incremental real failures beyond one-trace and random baselines
Matched coverage/cost, negative and censored rows, no convenience-sample prevalence claim
Stop on zero incremental failures or failed soundness/practical gates

nodes.objective: Produce a positive thesis and reproducible artifact only if supported
acceptance: Renewed hostile novelty review
All claims mapped to evidence and uncertainty
Responsible disclosure and third-party licenses satisfied
Sole human authorship and required assistance disclosure; no promised acceptance

nodes.activation: Only when a scientific gate is killed or irreducibly blocked; not a parallel positive claim
nodes.objective: Complete an honest negative or blocked research closeout
inputs: The recorded failed/blocked gate decision and immutable evidence
acceptance: Exact failed claim, strongest null, attempted correction and preserved evidence
No missing result recast as success
Document what is useful and what must not be claimed
Explicit human decision before a material pivot
downstream_evidence: Closed research record or separately authorized new selection
